latest_patch.notes: Title Update 1.73 shipped Jul 14 (Legacy 1.0.3889.0, Enhanced 1.0.1158.13). On Sep 15, 2026 Rockstar pushed a PC Enhanced-only update ('General fixes') that moved Enhanced to 1.0.1158.16; Legacy is unchanged. Script Hook V (dev-c.com, checked by hand 2026-10-18) still lists only 1.0.3889.0 / 1.0.1158.13, so it does not support current Enhanced. Corrected in the 2026-10-18 audit; earlier checks had treated the Sep 15 item as an event update.
